Header placement and one-definition requirements also remain relevant when specializations are shared across translation units.

blocks.text: A full specialization supplies a distinct implementation for one complete set of template arguments. The category example gives bool a specific label rather than using the primary template’s general value label. This is a small, controlled demonstration of selection; it does not imply that Boolean values should be treated as ordinary numeric quantities in every generic algorithm.

blocks.text: Function templates do not support partial specialization in the same way class templates do. Function overloads and constraints are often the appropriate mechanisms for those cases. Confusing the two models can lead to surprising syntax and lookup behavior. Use class specialization when customizing a class family and overloads or constrained functions when selecting function behavior.

blocks.text: A trait class is a useful application because its interface can remain tiny and stable: a constant, a type alias, or a Boolean property. That makes specialization review manageable. A full application class with radically different member sets in every specialization is much harder to substitute safely. Prefer the smallest customization surface that represents the intended variation.

topics.title: Failure clinic — One unchecked multiplication
topics.summary: A matrix template computes its storage size with an unchecked product of dimensions. On a target where that product wraps in the size type, the array can be smaller than the programmer intended. Later indexing then operates against the wrong representation. The repair is a representability constraint before multiplication, plus an application-level policy limiting impractically large shapes.

topics.title: Review and solution reasoning
topics.summary: Class templates create concrete type families. Constant dimensions can enforce shape constraints, but runtime coordinates still need checks. Specializations select implementations under compile-time rules and should preserve the intended family interface. A reusable representation remains responsible for ownership, overflow boundaries, and understandable diagnostics just as a non-template class does.
